question: Should memory-lancedb permanently expose all three recall controls, including candidate overfetch, or expose only direct user policy while deriving the retrieval pool internally?
rationale: The code and proof establish that the implementation works, but the relationship between overfetch, filtering, result cap, latency, and prompt budget makes the supported public contract a maintainer product choice.

options.title: Expose threshold and cap
options.body: Keep recallMinScore and recallResultCap as direct operator policy and derive overfetch from the cap and filtering strategy.

options.title: Expose all three
options.body: Accept candidate overfetch as a supported advanced setting and explicitly document and test its interaction with the result cap and resource bounds.

options.title: Decline new settings
options.body: Retain the current fixed internal policy until a concrete supported tuning use case warrants configuration expansion.

recommendation.title: Expose threshold and cap
recommendation.body: Keep recallMinScore and recallResultCap as direct operator policy and derive overfetch from the cap and filtering strategy.
